== Acquisition ==
This skill is only available while under the [[Godly Yuletide]] effect during [[Wintersday]].

== Notes ==
{{bug|The hex is not applied to the target. It is applied to all foes within range along with each damage pulse.}}
{{bug|The effect lasts for 10 seconds, not 5.}}
{{bug|The cripple lasts for 5 seconds, not 2.}}
